item.title: WATCH- Suryakumar Yadav and wife Devisha visit Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple, Tirupati before T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: Ahead of the ICC T20 World Cup 2026 that begins on February 7, India T20I captain Suryakumar Yadav, along with his wife Devisha, visited the Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple in Tirupati on Tuesday, December 30, 2025, marking the auspicious occasion of Vaikunta Ekadashi. item.title: Shreyas Iyer’s return unlikely in New Zealand ODI series as India vice-captain loses 6kg weight post spleen injury: Report
item.description: Shreyas Iyer’s return to competitive action has hit a major roadblock as the Indian ODI vice-captain is yet to receive fitness clearance from the BCCI’s Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Bengaluru. Iyer has been on the sidelines since suffering a spleen injury while fielding during the third ODI against Australia at SCG in October this year. item.title: RCB, DC rocked by Ellyse Perry and Annabel Sutherland pullouts ahead of WPL 2026
item.description: Australian all-rounders Ellyse Perry and Annabel Sutherland on Tuesday (December 30) pulled out of the upcoming Women's Premier League (WPL) season, citing personal reasons. Perry and Sutherland are associated with Royal Challengers Bengaluru and Delhi Capitals in the T20 tournament. item.title: Sri Lanka rope in Lasith Malinga as consultant pace-bowling coach ahead of T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC) on Tuesday (December 30) roped in Lasith Malinga as consultant pace-bowling coach for the national men's team ahead of the T20 World Cup 2026, set to be held in India and Sri Lanka from February 7 to March 8. item.title: WATCH- Glenn Phillips turns left-hander; smashes amazing boundaries batting southpaw in Super Smash game
item.description: Glenn Phillips, the star New Zealand all-rounder, has shown a new skill in his quiver in the ongoing Super Smash tournament. Naturally a right-handed batter, Phillips turned left-handed and still managed to hammer some powerful shots for fours and even hit a six over covers. item.description: The England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) has reportedly conducted a private investigation into reports that several England cricketers, including Ben Duckett, Jacob Bethell, and Harry Brook, amongst others, indulged in overdrinking during their break in Queensland’s Noosa during the ongoing Ashes 2025-26. item.title: “2025 has been really great for us,” says Harmanpreet Kaur after guiding India 5-0 win over Sri Lanka in T20I series
item.description: Bowlers backed up skipper Harmanpreet Kaur's brilliant half-century as India defeated Sri Lanka by 15 runs in the fifth and final T20I to complete a 5-0 series whitewash in Thiruvananthapuram on Tuesday (December 30). Harmanpreet’s first fifty of the series came at a crucial time when India was reeling at 77/5. Her 43-ball 68 propelled the hosts to 175/5 in 20 overs.
